traditional: The body and daily needs combined with communication and commerce.

modern.blend: Emotion meets mind. How feeling and thinking inform each other, and how readily the inner life gets put into words.
modern.harmonious: Thought and communication flow; expression is instinctive and fluent.
modern.hard: Gut instinct argues with logic. Either feelings go unspoken or they get said unfiltered, without being thought through.
modern.business: Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
